title: Hosted Rollout + Rollback Procedure (Runtime Changes)
body:
h2. Scope
Use this procedure for production rollouts to the Hosted API fleet covering:
* serving runtime image updates
* request router changes

h2. Preconditions
* Hotfix image built and signed (see /eng-infra/ci-cd-and-build/hotfix-build-and-signing)
* For hotfixes, emergency approvals captured (see /policies-and-process/change-management/emergency-change-policy-v2)
* A named rollout owner (Platform on-call or a delegated engineer)

h2. Rollout order
Standard sequence for runtime hotfixes:
# Canary: us-west-2a (5% traffic)
# Expand: us-west-2 (50% traffic)
# Expand: us-east-1 (50% traffic)
# Expand: eu-central-1 (50% traffic)
# Global: all regions

Where the incident looks region-specific, run the canary in a healthy region first to confirm there is no regression.

h2. Canary criteria (check each explicitly)
Monitor for 10 minutes minimum:
* Request success rate (2xx / completed streams)
* p95 latency on the top 3 routes
* GPU OOM rate
* Router fallback rate
* Error budget burn rate

Canary passes when:
* No sustained error rate increase > 0.2% absolute
* p95 latency not worse than +15% vs previous runtime
* No new crash-looping pods

h2. Rollout execution
1. Post in the incident channel (or #eng-releases) that the rollout is starting, including the tag.
2. Update the deploy config:
   * runtime_image_tag = <new-tag>
3. Apply via Spinnaker: 'hosted-runtime' pipeline
4. Wait for steady state before raising traffic weight.

h2. Rollback triggers
Roll back right away if any of these happen:
* 5xx/stream aborts above threshold for > 5 minutes
* GPU OOM rate > 2x baseline
* p95 latency regression > 20% for > 10 minutes
* customer reports line up with the rollout start

h2. Rollback procedure
1. Revert runtime_image_tag to the last known good tag.
2. Re-run the Spinnaker 'hosted-runtime' pipeline.
3. Confirm steady state and that errors drop.
4. Post in the incident channel: rollback done, short reason, next step.

h2. Post-rollout
* Update the incident timeline and comms per /oncall-and-incident-response/incident-process/sev1-communication-requirements
* File a follow-up to merge the hotfix into the next regular release branch
